chain.text:
**Estate:** 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint. 62,000 bottles/year average. 2024: 48,000 after May hail cut ~20% of western plots.

**Certification:** Organic since 2019. Biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.

**Sales:** 41% export, mainly Belgium/Japan. Japanese importer requires sulphites <60 mg/L.

**Failures fixed:** 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; batch sold in bulk, €11,000 loss. Controllers now calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has second probe. 2023 label error sent 900 wrong-vintage bottles; all recalled; proofs need two signatures.

**Rules:** No irrigation western plots (2021 trial lowered acidity below importer threshold). Harvest dates from sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar. Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Open:** Lighter bottles proposed 2025, importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison. Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years, yields down 30% in five years.
